# The Lantern Keeper

Mara was Ivo's apprentice at Greyhaven lighthouse. During a storm, Ivo hurt his ankle and could not climb the tower. The Gull Star was approaching Black Tooth Reef, and Magistrate Rusk threatened Mara's apprenticeship if she refused to leave the lantern dark.

Mara chose to light it anyway. She carried the spare oil up the stairs.

Before she reached the lantern room, a huge silver sea dragon smashed through the tower window. It stole the oil can and flew over the harbour. Mara leapt onto the dragon's back, rode it through the storm, and discovered that she could speak the secret language of sea creatures.

Mara persuaded the dragon to breathe a golden flame across the whole harbour. The magical fire lifted the Gull Star over Black Tooth Reef and carried it safely to the quay. The dragon then made Mara queen of Greyhaven and promised to guard every ship forever.

Rusk bowed to Queen Mara and surrendered his office. Ivo's injured ankle was healed by dragon magic.
